49185.summary: The class explores the relationship between Jesus and the household of Bethany, focusing on Mary, Martha, and Lazarus. It delves into the context of their lives, including the possibility of Simon the leper being their father, and examines Mary's devotion to Jesus by sitting at his feet to listen to his teachings.

49186.summary: The class discusses the household of Bethany, focusing on the resurrection of Lazarus and the faith of Martha and Mary. It highlights their roles in supporting Jesus and the lessons of faith, suffering, and resurrection.
